name: gizza-ai/image-shrink-for-sharing
summary: Downscale, strip metadata, and compress an image for sharing in one step.

tool.description: Shrink an image for messaging or upload: downscale the longest side, strip EXIF/GPS metadata, and re-encode at a chosen quality (optionally converting format) in one pass. Provide either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior image tool call). Supports jpg/jpeg, png, webp.

format.description: Output format: keep uses the input's format; jpeg and webp shrink photos most; png suits flat graphics/screenshots. Default keep.

max_dimension.description: Cap the longest side to this many pixels; aspect ratio is kept and the image is never upscaled. 0 keeps the original size. Default 1600.

quality.description: Re-encode quality from 1 (smallest file) to 100 (best looking). Default 80.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

strip_metadata.description: Remove EXIF, GPS location and other metadata for privacy. Default true.

url.description: Image URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.
